summary: Kenon Holdings Ltd. filed a Form 6-K with exhibits reporting Q2 2026 results and operational updates. The filing discloses receipt of approximately $93 million from Peru related to an ICSID arbitration award, OPC's Q2 net profit of $15 million versus $1 million year-over-year, and OPC's financing and EPC agreements for the Hadera expansion project. No special-situation transaction such as acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or restructuring is announced. The report is routine earnings disclosure by a foreign private issuer, lacking any transformative corporate event. What to watch: ordinary quarterly operational performance and project financing developments.
